# Scalix Labs

> Scalix Labs is a web development and custom software engineering agency. We specialize in building high-performance, conversion-focused websites, custom web applications, SaaS platforms, and scalable digital growth systems using modern technologies like Next.js, React, Node.js, and cloud architectures. We collaborate with founders, startups, and enterprises across EdTech, Real Estate, Co-Living, E-Commerce, and modern tech sectors.

## Core Services
- [Web Development](https://www.scalixlabs.in/#services): Conversion-focused websites built with Next.js, React, and modern frameworks. High-speed architecture optimized for search engines, mobile responsiveness, and lead capture.
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.scalixlabs.in/#services): Bespoke web applications, SaaS platforms, CRM systems, real estate listing portals, and business tools tailored to specific operational requirements.
- [Performance Marketing](https://www.scalixlabs.in/#services): Structured acquisition advertising across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn designed to lower acquisition costs and scale ROI.
- [Lead Generation Systems](https://www.scalixlabs.in/#services): Automated marketing funnels that capture high-intent inquiries and nurture them with WhatsApp and CRM integration.
- [SEO & Organic Growth](https://www.scalixlabs.in/#services): Technical SEO audits, local search visibility, keyword mapping, schema markup, and authority building.

## Selected Case Studies
- [YUKTA VERSE](https://www.scalixlabs.in/work/yuktaverse): AI & Technology Learning Platform. Built an end-to-end digital learning experience with custom program discovery, mentor trust architecture, and enrollment consultation funnels resulting in a 150% growth surge. Live at yuktaverse.com.
- [SLN HOMES](https://www.scalixlabs.in/work/sln-homes): Residential & Co-Living Web Platform in Bengaluru. Designed a mobile-first accommodation portal with room configuration showcases, transit landmark proximity, and one-tap WhatsApp booking channels delivering a +240% inquiry increase. Live at slnhomes.in.
- [V2 PROPERTIES](https://www.scalixlabs.in/work/v2-properties): Luxury Real Estate Discovery & Advisory Portal. Engineered a sophisticated property portal showcasing luxury apartments, villas, and commercial real estate with high-intent investor qualification funnels.

## Track Record & Outcomes
- 4,500+ Qualified leads and inquiries generated for clients
- 150% Average client growth rate
- Sub-second performance & 99+ Lighthouse scores on Next.js platforms
- Active collaborations across EdTech, Real Estate, Co-Living, SaaS, Healthcare, and B2B Services

## Technology Stack
Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Vercel, Docker, n8n automation
